reading.cost: The page offers the option to join for free and says a subscription unlocks access to more than 10,000 courses. It also refers to purchasing a Certificate, which gives access to all course materials including graded assignments, but it does not state a price.
covers: Common AI terminology including neural networks, machine learning, deep learning and data science
What AI realistically can and cannot do
Spotting opportunities to apply AI to problems in your own organization
What it feels like to build machine learning and data science projects
Working with an AI team and building an AI strategy
Ethical and societal discussions surrounding AI
Workflow of a machine learning project
reading.format: The course is delivered as video lessons grouped into sections, with a total stated duration of 71 minutes. The page lists graded assignments as part of the course materials available with a purchased Certificate.
reading.summary: This is an introductory course about artificial intelligence aimed at a general audience. It explains common AI terms such as neural networks, machine learning, deep learning and data science, and what AI can and cannot do. It also covers how to find opportunities to use AI in an organization, how to work with an AI team, and how to build an AI strategy. Completing it gives a broad, largely non-technical understanding of AI and its business and societal implications.
reading.audience: The page says AI is not only for engineers and that the course is for anyone who wants their organization to use AI better, especially non-technical colleagues. It adds that engineers can also take it to learn the business side of AI.
reading.prerequisites: The page lists the course at beginner level and describes it as largely non-technical. It does not state any required prior knowledge or experience.
